title: Databricks Genie: What It Is & How To Use It In 2026
summary: Databricks Genie explained: Genie One vs Genie Agents (formerly Genie spaces), setup, API, Slack and Teams, pricing, limits, and when GetDot fits.
body_markdown:
**Accuracy is the curation.** An agent knows only its tables and the context you wrote. Practitioners report plausible answers to questions an agent can't actually answer, built from a nearby metric (see the user reports in our[Databricks Genie vs Dot comparison](https://www.getdot.ai/compare/databricks-vs-dot) ). Benchmarks catch that only if you add questions the agent should decline and review those answers by hand. Our text-to-SQL tools guide has a test plan for any tool.


**Permissions follow the asker, including in channels.** That is precise in a DM and a trade-off in a shared channel: when someone with broad access asks in Slack or Teams, everyone in the channel sees the rows. Decide which channels get the app before you install it.


## When GetDot fits alongside or instead of Genie


GetDot (Dot) is an[AI data analyst](https://www.getdot.ai/blog/ai-data-analyst) that answers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, its web app and MCP clients, with the SQL behind every number. It connects to Databricks with a service principal or personal access token and runs its queries on a SQL warehouse you choose ([Databricks integration](https://www.getdot.ai/integrations/databricks) ):


- **It starts from your lakehouse, not a blank space.** Dot reads Unity Catalog (or Hive metastore) table and column comments, learns from recent query history in` system.query.history` , and sees only what its credential is granted.
- **It reaches past Unity Catalog.** Dot connects 45+ sources, including Snowflake, BigQuery and Postgres, and answers through dbt, LookML, Power BI semantic models and Malloy, with no federation step.
- **It trains against answers you trust.** Train tests Dot on questions with trusted answers, investigates the misses, fixes notes, relationships and table docs in an isolated environment, and reports accuracy before and after ([September 2026 changelog](https://www.getdot.ai/changelog/2026-09-01-train-dot) ). Genie's benchmarks score an agent and leave the fixing to its author, with Genie Code's agent-maintenance skills (July 2026) to help.
- **Channels have their own identity.** Each Slack channel gets the groups and limits an admin grants, so it sees only that, whoever asks. Direct messages run as the person, with row-level security on the Team plan.
- **Analysis beyond one query.** Dot uses Python where SQL falls short, runs multi-step[deep analysis](https://www.getdot.ai/deep-analysis) , schedules reports and alerts with plain-English conditions, and exports PowerPoint.


[Choco](https://www.getdot.ai/impact/choco) uses Dot as the front door to its data in Looker and Databricks and reports 3,300+ hours saved a year and an estimated 18x ROI (customer-reported).


Where Genie wins: it is part of your Databricks account, so there is no new vendor to review; Unity Catalog permissions apply per person with no setup; it runs inside your workspace, while Dot is a separate service that syncs metadata and samples; and people use it free through January 2027. Dot is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, its LLM providers run with zero data retention, and Enterprise can be self-hosted. Pricing (October 2026), unlimited users, billed on credits: Free $0 with 300 one-time credits; Pro $180 a month billed annually ($200 monthly) with 150 credits; Team $720 a month billed annually ($800 monthly) with 800 credits. A chat answer costs one credit.


**Choose Genie** when your data and your people live in Databricks, questions fit a few curated domains, and someone will own each agent and its benchmarks. **Add or choose GetDot** when questions cross Databricks and other sources or semantic layers, most people ask from Slack, Teams or email, or you want an analyst that trains against trusted answers. See the side-by-side in our[Databricks Genie vs Dot comparison](https://www.getdot.ai/compare/databricks-vs-dot) , or[try Dot free](https://app.getdot.ai/register) on your Databricks SQL warehouse.
